note: The task kinds of docs/plans/phase-6-administration.md, section Task Kinds, each with its treatment (legs 6-kinds and 6-cleanup, rulings KN1 to KN4 and CL8). types are the rows with a type id: the four ids of the content fixture (testdata/export/fixture-content/qrtz_job_details.jsonl) and the ids of this server, marked own; a built type carries its fields in the shape of the task type list of the contract. classes are the kinds without a known id, with the number of kinds of the capture each holds; their ids are an owner point. A stored task of a type not listed here stays disabled as not known. internal/tasks holds a Go copy, and a test fails when the two differ.

type.name: Compact blob store
type.description: Removes the blobs of a store of this server whose delete mark is older than the given days, with their files.

type.name: Back up the state file
type.description: Copies state.sqlite while the server runs into a new file in a directory outside the data directory.

type.name: Run cleanup policies
type.description: Runs every cleanup policy over the repositories that name it, all of them or the one given, and removes what each selects.

type.name: Remove Maven snapshots
type.description: Removes the snapshot builds of a hosted Maven repository that are older than the given days, beyond the newest builds of each snapshot version that are kept, and writes the metadata of the touched versions again.

type.name: Rebuild Maven metadata
type.description: Writes the maven-metadata.xml files and their checksums of a hosted Maven repository again from the files it holds.

types.class: rescan of a store, which replaces the browse rebuild

type.name: Rescan blob store
type.description: Reads every file of a blob store again and rebuilds its part of the index, the catalog and its counts.

types.class: removal of stale docker upload sessions

type.name: Purge Docker uploads
type.description: Ends the Docker upload sessions that had no request for longer than the given hours and removes their work files.

types.class: removal of temporary and orphaned files of a store

type.name: Remove old work files
type.description: Removes the work files below content/tmp of a store of this server that are older than the given hours and that no running upload holds.
